scenes.context: 简单不出彩但百搭的技巧，就像牛仔裤。
sentences: 首先他们做起来非常简单，不会像那些酷炫的特效场面那么复杂和显眼。
First, they're simple—nothing like flashy, complex effects.
simple tricks（简单技巧）
也正因为如此，他们很难产生审美疲劳。
And precisely that makes them hard to grow tired of.
no fatigue（不疲劳）
这样的技巧就像一条牛仔裤或者一双白球鞋一样，可以被称之为百搭单品。
These tricks are like jeans or white sneakers—true basics.
wardrobe basics（百搭单品）
scenes.speak: First, they're simple—nothing like flashy, complex effects. And precisely that makes them hard to grow tired of. These tricks are like jeans or white sneakers—true basics.

scenes.context: 定格打断情绪，反向利用制造艺术感。
sentences: 我给画面施加了一个定格的效果，你几乎可以在任何剪辑软件中一键实现它。
I applied a freeze-frame—one click in almost any editor.
freeze frame（定格）
连贯的动作被停住了，整个情绪被打断了。
The fluid motion stops and the emotion is cut.
emotion cut（情绪打断）
不妨逆向思维，把之前难受的点加以利用。
Think in reverse and exploit the very discomfort.
reverse thinking（逆向思维）
有些画面在某一瞬间定格，真的比连贯起来更有艺术性。
Some shots frozen at one instant are more artistic than flowing footage.
artistic freeze（定格艺术）
scenes.speak: I applied a freeze-frame—one click in almost any editor. The fluid motion stops and the emotion is cut. Think in reverse and exploit the very discomfort. Some shots frozen at one instant are more artistic than flowing footage.

scenes.context: 定格+运动模糊，截取最有动感的一帧。
sentences: 有的情节直接演出来难免会很假，尤其是一些动作场面。
Some scenes acted out directly are inevitably fake, especially action.
fake acting（表演太假）
原地甩动，把运动模糊给擦出来，再截取最有动感的那一帧。
Whip in place to drag motion blur, then freeze the most dynamic frame.
motion blur（运动模糊）
这种定格画面快切在电影里也会被用来制造压缩时间的蒙太奇。
This freeze-cut montage is used in film to compress time.
compress time（压缩时间）
scenes.speak: Some scenes acted out directly are inevitably fake, especially action. Whip in place to drag motion blur, then freeze the most dynamic frame. This freeze-cut montage is used in film to compress time.

scenes.context: 开头标题、结尾抽离、众生相。
sentences: 像开头出标题啊，结尾的时候让观众情绪抽离出来啊。
Titles at the start, or letting the emotion pull away at the end.
titles and release（标题与抽离）
或者是想让观众注意画面中的众生相。
Or drawing attention to the crowd in a frame.
crowd in frame（众生相）
我几乎每期视频都会用到这个技巧，真的非常百搭。
I use it in almost every episode—truly versatile.
truly versatile（非常百搭）
scenes.speak: Titles at the start, or letting the emotion pull away at the end. Or drawing attention to the crowd in a frame. I use it in almost every episode—truly versatile.

scenes.context: 低快门+快速变焦呈现复古幽默感。
sentences: 很随意地拉一下焦段，又能吸引注意力，又能让画面的动态更加丰富。
Casually pulling the zoom grabs attention and enriches motion.
pull the zoom（拉焦段）
当我把快门速度调低的时候，这种快速变焦就会呈现出一种老武侠片的感觉。
With a low shutter speed, the quick zoom takes on an old wuxia feel.
old wuxia feel（老武侠感）
很多导演像昆汀、韦斯·安德森都很喜欢使用它，可以用来强调某个信息。
Directors like Tarantino and Wes Anderson love it—to stress information.
stress a point（强调信息）
scenes.speak: Casually pulling the zoom grabs attention and enriches motion. With a low shutter speed, the quick zoom takes on an old wuxia feel. Directors like Tarantino and Wes Anderson love it—to stress information.

scenes.title_cn: 拍法前提与结合：当然，拍摄这样的画面…
scenes.context: 大跨度变焦镜头，或后期打关键帧。
sentences: 我们需要的一颗焦段跨度比较大的变焦镜头。
You need a zoom lens with a large focal-length range.
wide zoom range（大跨度变焦）
可以通过后期给缩放打关键帧来实现类似的效果。
You can fake it in post by keyframing the scale.
keyframe the scale（关键帧缩放）
我还是更喜欢实拍出来的质感。
I still prefer the texture of real shooting.
real texture（实拍质感）
scenes.speak: You need a zoom lens with a large focal-length range. You can fake it in post by keyframing the scale. I still prefer the texture of real shooting.

practice: Freeze interrupts emotion—use it in reverse.
Freeze with motion blur for artistic frames.
Low shutter + quick zoom gives retro humor.
Wide-range zoom lens, or keyframe in post.
pitfalls: Simple tricks are the versatile basics.
Let freezing break your flow unintentionally.
Freeze on purpose at the artistic instant.
定格要刻意用在艺术瞬间。
Freeze the most dynamic frame instead.
Keyframe the scale in post if you lack one.
没有变焦就后期打关键帧。
Ignore shutter speed with quick zoom.
Low shutter gives the retro wuxia feel.
shifts: 用 versatile basics（百搭单品）、wardrobe basics（牛仔裤白球鞋）
用 freeze frame（定格）、motion blur（运动模糊）、compress time（压缩时间）
用 quick zoom（快速变焦）、old wuxia feel（老武侠感）、keyframe the scale（关键帧缩放）
